ideas.pitch: An AI-powered codebase visualization and architecture mapping tool designed specifically for rapid comprehension of unfamiliar repositories during live engineering assessments.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: AI Code Comprehension Challenge (In-person) - Shortlisted teams will be provided with an unfamiliar codebase. Teams must analyse the codebase, understand its architecture and execution flow, and identify and fix bugs.
ideas.title: LegacyLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the exact requirements of Round 2 by giving judges an interactive GUI to visualize execution flow and pinpoint architectural bottlenecks in an unfamiliar codebase.

ideas.pitch: An agentic debugging companion that ingests runtime stack traces, performs root-cause analysis across multiple files in an unfamiliar repo, and generates structured pull requests with unit tests.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: AI Code Comprehension Challenge (In-person) - Shortlisted teams will be provided with an unfamiliar codebase. Teams must analyse the codebase, understand its architecture and execution flow, and identify and fix bugs.
ideas.title: AutoFixer Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a proven hackathon winner by automating the exact multi-file bug fixing and test generation task required in the competition's core evaluation criteria.

ideas.pitch: An interactive prompt engineering sandbox and evaluation suite designed to test, benchmark, and optimize prompts against edge-case code generation scenarios.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Build with AI - Interested students will have the opportunity to attend an offline workshop covering Prompt Engineering, Git & GitHub, and Agentic AI tools, followed by a quiz.
ideas.title: PromptGuard Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core workshop curriculum of Mantrastra (Prompt Engineering and Agentic AI), offering a tangible tool that helps developers systematically refine and evaluate their prompts.

ideas.pitch: An automated code diff comprehension tool that explains architectural changes, detects unintended side effects, and summarizes complex pull requests for rapid code reviews.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: AI Code Comprehension Challenge (In-person) - Shortlisted teams will be provided with an unfamiliar codebase. Teams must analyse the codebase, understand its architecture and execution flow, and identify and fix bugs.
ideas.title: RepoDiff Insight
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the pain point of understanding unfamiliar code quickly by turning raw git diffs and unfamiliar modules into structured, human-readable summaries and dependency maps.

ideas.pitch: An integrated VS Code extension that provides intelligent auto-completion, real-time bug explanation, and GUI-driven fix implementation for unfamiliar software engineering tasks.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: AI Code Comprehension Challenge (In-person) - Shortlisted teams will be provided with an unfamiliar codebase. Teams must analyse the codebase, understand its architecture and execution flow, and identify and fix bugs.
ideas.title: AgenticCode Pilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of an AI-based IDE extension with a fully functional GUI that judges can interact with live during their evaluation of code comprehension and debugging speed.
